name: influencer.brand_link
description: Links a person to a brand of their own company, which a post's Collaborators and Tag people then suggest them for. Linked already, nothing changes. Answers the ids of the person's brands.
sql:
with added as (
  insert into brandbase.influencer_brands (influencer_id, brand_id, org_id)
  select i.id, :brand, i.org_id from brandbase.influencers i where i.id = :id::uuid
  on conflict (influencer_id, brand_id) do nothing
  returning brand_id
)
select jsonb_build_object('id', :id::uuid, 'brands', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(s.brand_id order by s.brand_id) from (select l.brand_id from brandbase.influencer_brands l where l.influencer_id = :id::uuid union select a.brand_id from added a) s), '[]'::jsonb)) as result
